nodes.title: Audit QRS code, environment, licenses, and upstream contracts
acceptance: Lifecycle and persistence extension points are mapped to concrete symbols
Unity, Android, CUDA, Python, and GPU availability are recorded
DiffSoup and server licenses plus exact input/output contracts are recorded
evidence: docs/architecture/UPSTREAM_AUDIT.md pins all three upstream commits and maps scanner, volume, mesh, persistence, keyframe, anchor, refinement, and export extension points
Audit records QRS and DiffSoup MIT licenses and the missing license artifact in the pinned Gaussian server repository
Audit records the exact DiffSoup mesh/LUT/MLP artifact, training-adapter gap, resumable-checkpoint requirements, and verified machine/device/build baseline

nodes.title: Create named GitHub fork and safe upstream/origin topology
acceptance: origin points to the writable fork and upstream to QuestRoomScan
feature branch exists on the fork without rewriting upstream history
evidence: origin is the writable fork; upstream fetches QuestRoomScan and has push URL DISABLED
origin/feat/infinite-submaps-diffsoup exists at audited upstream commit 2fdaaae71f60b21b7853e67db943fc42f75d0c2f

nodes.title: Implement versioned world, chunk, bounds, revision, and pose-graph domain model
acceptance: JSON round trips preserve transforms and identifiers
Malformed/unsupported manifests fail closed
Pose graph can update world transforms without changing local geometry

nodes.title: Implement atomic world/chunk persistence and migration-safe layout
acceptance: world/chunks layout is versioned and atomically committed
Legacy single-scan packages still load
Interrupted writes cannot replace last known-good metadata

nodes.title: Implement SubmapManager rollover, overlap, hysteresis, and bounded active set
acceptance: Camera world pose is transformed into active chunk-local space
Boundary traversal rolls chunks without oscillation
Resident volume count stays within configured limit

nodes.title: Integrate chunk lifecycle with scanner, TSDF reuse, finalization, and rendering
acceptance: Existing mapper kernels remain compatible
Finalization and reload do not block the scan frame loop on file/network I/O
Nearby persisted chunk meshes can be shown with correct transforms

nodes.title: Route keyframes, atlas refinement, anchors, and revisions per chunk
acceptance: Frames and poses are stored in chunk-local coordinates
Revisit creates a monotonic revision with newly selected observations
Triplanar defaults off only in explicitly enabled large-world mode

nodes.title: Define and test versioned LAN job and DiffSoup artifact contracts
acceptance: Jobs are idempotently keyed by world/chunk/revision
Upload and artifact hashes/sizes/versions are validated
Client can retry, cancel, poll, and remain offline safely

nodes.title: Implement local server API, durable job store, scheduler, and fake backend
acceptance: API contract tests pass without CUDA
Restart preserves terminal jobs and safely recovers interrupted jobs
Path traversal, zip bombs, oversized uploads, and duplicate submissions are rejected

nodes.title: Integrate pinned upstream DiffSoup CUDA worker and warm-start revisions
acceptance: QRS mesh/keyframes are converted to verified DiffSoup inputs
Worker emits the canonical artifact or a structured failure
Supported revisits warm-start; unsupported cases safely fall back to a fresh job

nodes.title: Implement Unity heavy-compute interface, LAN backend, scheduler, and offline queue
acceptance: None and LAN backends share one lifecycle
Jobs survive transient network loss and stale responses cannot overwrite newer revisions
No network await occurs in the real-time integration path

nodes.title: Implement validated DiffSoupArtifact import, persistence, and atomic promotion
acceptance: Artifact parser is bounded and rejects corrupt indices/dimensions/versions
Artifact is stored by chunk/revision/hash
Promotion is atomic and keeps the prior renderer on any error

nodes.title: Port DiffSoup triangle/LUT appearance renderer to Unity URP
acceptance: Reference artifact renders with coordinate/color parity against upstream viewer
Stereo, depth, culling, relocation, and resource disposal work on Quest
Unsupported appearance networks are rejected or baked to a supported representation

nodes.title: Implement overlap constraints, ICP interface, and pose-graph optimization
acceptance: Neighbor constraints carry covariance/confidence and provenance
Synthetic graph tests reduce loop error
Optimization changes only chunk world transforms

nodes.title: Wire setup wizard, UI/status, diagnostics, and large-world defaults
acceptance: Setup is idempotent and existing single-room setup remains available
Operators can see chunk, queue, storage, graph, network, and artifact state
Large-world default memory settings are explicit

nodes.title: Implement deterministic chunk GLB 2.0 writer and honest PBR material export
acceptance: Refined or enhanced mesh exports positions, normals, generated tangents, UV0, indices, base color, and normal texture
Material uses metallicFactor=0 and configurable constant roughness without inventing measured maps
Coordinate handedness, winding, texture orientation, alignment, and GLB length fields pass golden tests

nodes.title: Implement pose-graph world export as chunk nodes, sharded GLBs, and optional bounded monolithic GLB
acceptance: World export applies the current T_world_chunk exactly once and preserves chunk names/revisions
Large worlds stream to a versioned building manifest plus per-chunk GLBs without loading every mesh/texture at once
Monolithic export enforces configurable size/resource limits and fails with an actionable sharded-export fallback

nodes.title: Validate GLB interoperability and add optional compression capability negotiation
acceptance: Chunk and world fixtures pass Khronos glTF Validator with no errors
Fixtures import with correct PBR textures/transforms in an independent consumer
meshopt and KTX2/BasisU are emitted only when a verified available implementation and declared extension support exist; uncompressed GLB remains mandatory fallback

nodes.title: Automated validation, migration, failure-injection, and performance harness
acceptance: Unit/contract/integration tests pass
Offline, corrupt artifact, interrupted write, duplicate job, and server restart cases pass
Profiling records frame time and resident memory as chunk count grows

nodes.title: Unity Android build and Quest 3S end-to-end acceptance
acceptance: Vulkan ARM64 build installs and starts
Multi-chunk scan continues with notebook disconnected
CUDA-refined artifact returns and swaps atomically
Reload/anchor relocation/revisit and bounded active memory pass on device

nodes.title: Finalize operator/developer runbooks, compatibility notes, and release
acceptance: Fresh-machine setup and recovery runbooks are reproducible
Licenses/notices and pinned dependencies are complete
Goal state and release evidence match the shipped commit
